entities.summary: Edmundo Bal Francés is a Spanish lawyer and politician. As a member of the State Lawyers Corps, he prosecuted La Liga footballers for tax avoidance, members of the governing People's Party for corruption, and proponents of the Catalan independence movement for sedition.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edmundo Bal Francés is a Spanish lawyer and politician. As a member of the State Lawyers Corps, he prosecuted La Liga footballers for tax avoidance, members of the governing People's Party for corruption, and proponents of the Catalan independence movement for sedition.
